description.value: The Local Harvest Market is a family-run farm and market in Chilliwack offering fresh, seasonal produce grown on-site using 100% chemical-free, permaculture and regenerative agriculture methods. The market carries vegetables, herbs, fruits, legumes, flowers, and baked goods, with much of the produce harvested from their fields the same day it reaches the counter. They also offer compost, worm castings, and periodic farm-to-table long table dinners, making it a distinctive stop beyond a conventional grocery run.
